outputProtocol.verdict: Choose exactly one of the eight v3 criteria; only valid_as_defined passes.
outputProtocol.diagnosticFields: Also select concrete finding, affected file/requirement, observed evidence, proposed action/nextAction, and remainingUncertainty. If no finding choose none consistently. Reconcile the prior setup_cleanup_contract inconsistency explicitly; distinguish practical 4.1.11 tested behaviors from untested docs claims.
outputProtocol.conditionalFollowup: If initial verdict is any valid non-pass including indeterminate, preserve exact initial decision summary and probability distribution, generate at least two mutually exclusive case-specific immediate next actions (each targets code OR plan OR OpenSpec OR evidence-only, never multiple), supply the same finding/affected requirement/evidence or neededEvidence in each option, and call one follow-up only. Require choice ID, finding, affected location/requirement, observed evidence or exact neededEvidence, concrete nextAction/proposedFix and remainingUncertainty (explicit none). On adequate answer preserve initial distribution and set effectiveVerdict exactly requires_revalidation; on incomplete/invalid/unselected/transport errors record unresolved/incomplete and do not chain. Initial valid_as_defined gets no follow-up.

implementation_verdict.instructions: Does completed Phase2 implementation and final verification meet the updated Phase2 acceptance criteria?

criteria.valid_as_defined: The completed Phase2 harness and runtime work meets the Phase2 acceptance criteria as written, supported by the supplied final evidence. Only this label is a pass.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A concrete contradiction remains between Phase2 implementation, the updated plan, OpenSpec, or the explicitly approved local pre-push/no-GitHub-Actions scope.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A specific required acceptance prerequisite/evidence remains missing despite reported completion.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The Phase2 implementation or execution evidence is materially incomplete. Identify what is missing; do not choose only because the full Next.js production runtime or external push was outside scope.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete Phase2 harness/config/test defect is evidenced.
criteria.scope_violation: The completed work violates the local pre-push-only/no-GitHub-Actions constraint or improperly finalizes/excludes any of the 33 Phase5 MAP-ineligible IDs.
criteria.indeterminate: The evidence cannot establish either acceptance or a concrete rejection.

case_finding.instructions: What concrete case-specific issue, if any, remains after implementation? Explicitly reconcile the prior setup_cleanup_contract selection with actual 4.1.11 runtime evidence.

criteria.no_material_issue: No material Phase2 defect remains; all scoped Phase2 acceptance criteria are met.
criteria.prior_setup_cleanup_concern_resolved: The prior review’s unsupported setup_cleanup_contract concern is now resolved by the concrete implementation and same-file passing isolation evidence.
criteria.prior_setup_cleanup_concern_unresolved: The prior setup_cleanup_contract concern remains, despite the new implementation/results; specify the affected behavior/evidence.
criteria.browser_mode_runtime_issue: A concrete runtime behavior, supported userEvent/API use, sequential state reset, or browser configuration fails.
criteria.test_suite_regression: The happy-dom/default suite, test:full, pre-push routing, or required test gate has a concrete regression.
criteria.plan_spec_mismatch: The implementation and updated Phase2 plan/OpenSpec acceptance text materially disagree.
criteria.unverified_claim: A reported verification result is not sufficiently evidenced to support acceptance.
criteria.scope_violation: The implementation exceeds approved local-only/no-GitHub-Actions scope or treats the 33 Phase5 IDs as final exclusions.
criteria.other_concrete_finding: Another concrete issue is shown by the evidence.

affected_location.instructions: Which exact source path/requirement is affected by the case finding? Select none if no issue remains.

criteria.none: No affected path/requirement because no material finding remains.
criteria.browser_setup: vitest.browser.config.ts; tests/browser-mode/setup.ts; Phase2 per-test cleanup and same-file isolation requirement.
criteria.shared_helper: tests/browser-mode/renderBrowserComponent.tsx; scoped shared React render helper requirement.
criteria.theme_specs: tests/browser-mode/ThemeToggle.browser.test.tsx and ThemeToggle-style.browser.test.tsx; retain locator/component browser examples.
criteria.default_suite: vitest.config.ts and package.json; happy-dom isolation/test:full requirements.
criteria.openspec: openspec/specs/nextjstest/spec.md new Phase2 Browser Mode setup/interaction scenarios.
criteria.prepush_boundary: Existing local pre-push changed/full routing; user says this is sufficient, no GitHub Actions changes.
criteria.phase5_boundary: The 33 MAP-ineligible IDs deferred for individual Phase5 investigation.
criteria.other_location: Another exact affected location shown in evidence.

evidence_assessment.instructions: What do the final reported executions prove, and what do they not prove?

criteria.final_results_support_acceptance: The submitted runtime implementation and final checks directly cover Phase2 acceptance, including actual execution on pinned Vitest 4.1.11.
criteria.same_file_isolation_proven: The same-file sequential isolation spec demonstrates actual cleanup of DOM/theme/localStorage/script-visible cookies/mock calls/spies on the pinned provider.
criteria.user_event_version_proven: The provider-backed `vitest/browser` userEvent and `expect.element` behavior used by Phase2 were executed successfully under pinned 4.1.11.
criteria.external_push_only_missing: Only an actual external git push is unverified; this is outside the local pre-push fixture/runtime acceptance claim.
criteria.phase5_not_done_by_design: The 33 per-ID MAP eligibility investigation remains deferred by design to Phase5 and is not a Phase2 gap.
criteria.specific_evidence_missing: A precise part of Phase2 acceptance lacks an observed result; identify it.
criteria.result_conflict: The reported results conflict with code or plan/spec state.
criteria.insufficient_to_decide: The evidence does not establish acceptance or a specific blocker.

proposed_next_action.instructions: What is the immediate next action? If Phase2 is accepted, continue to Phase3 and keep the per-ID Phase5 work deferred.

criteria.accept_phase2_and_continue: Accept Phase2 and continue to Phase3; preserve the local pre-push-only boundary and keep all 33 per-ID eligibility reviews in Phase5.
criteria.fix_code_only: Change implementation code/config/tests only to repair a concrete defect; do not change plan/spec or gather evidence as part of this action.
criteria.revise_plan_only: Revise only Phase2 plan wording to repair a concrete mismatch; do not change code/spec or collect evidence in this action.
criteria.revise_openspec_only: Revise only OpenSpec requirements to match the intended acceptance; do not change implementation/plan or collect evidence in this action.
criteria.collect_evidence_only: Collect only the specific missing evidence; do not change code, plan, or spec in this action.
criteria.hold_for_scope_decision: Hold only for a concrete conflict with explicit user-approved scope.

remaining_uncertainty.instructions: What uncertainty remains after real execution on pinned Vitest 4.1.11? Distinguish exercised behavior from untested rolling-doc claims.

criteria.none_for_phase2_acceptance: No blocking uncertainty remains for defined Phase2 acceptance; explicitly deferred external push/production integration/Phase5 items remain outside this phase.
criteria.vitest_411_behavior_remains_unknown: A specific Phase2 behavior on pinned Vitest 4.1.11 remains unverified; identify it.
criteria.browser_cache_precondition: The local browser binary path/install prerequisite prevents repeatable local execution and is not sufficiently documented.
criteria.trace_diagnostic_value: The trace/screenshot artifacts exist, but their diagnostic usability remains unverified and is required by Phase2 acceptance.
criteria.external_push: Actual external push not performed; determine whether that is required for Phase2 beyond successful local pre-push fixture verification.
criteria.phase5_scope: How the Phase5 investigation of the 33 IDs is preserved remains unclear.
